//: Enforces the design system's core invariant: component CSS consumes COLOUR only through semantic token variables (var(--color-…) / var(--components-…)), never as raw hex / named / rgb-hsl values, and never via a primitive colour variable (var(--primitive-color-…)). This is what makes brand-switching work at the component level. Scoped to component module CSS via the lint script. Non-colour primitives (e.g. var(--primitive-size-8)) are intentionally NOT covered here — see the CLAUDE.md note about that being a separate question.
